note: Per-board baseline. v2/ci/size-baseline.json (no board suffix) is the rock-5b-plus baseline the v2-ci size job reads today; this file is the OPi 5+ counterpart, ready for a per-board wiring. The producing build FAILED the [6b/9] boot-artifact gate on a dtb_name mismatch (manifest says rk3588s-orangepi-5-plus.dtb, vendor BSP 26.5.1 ships rk3588-orangepi-5-plus.dtb) — a boot-path naming defect, not a content defect, so the byte count is still a valid content measurement.
